sources.title: Public engineering note on small services
sources.content: Prefer minimal dependencies and readable functions. Keep cold-start latency below 15ms.

sources.title: Public repository implementation observation
sources.content: The implementation uses few dependencies and a performance budget. Cyclomatic complexity <= 5.

sources.title: Public review explaining an exception
sources.content: Reject dependency bloat, but do not avoid a dependency when it is required for security.
